samples.summary: `sheets export` writes its progress notice to stdout, contradicting the newly documented stdout=body / stderr=notices contract
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-export.ts:52-54 still does `if (!opts.quiet) console.log(`Exported to ${file}`)`. The diff redefines the stream contract (formatter.ts:21-24 and packages/cli/README.md:74-76: `--quiet` gates progress notices only, and "the body is the data callers redirect"). Every other notice in the package goes to stderr (`packages/cli/src/output/binary.ts:39`, `packages/cli/src/docs/content.ts:142`, `packages/cli/src/slides/content.ts:105`). This call site is the one progress notice left on stdout, so `sheets export doc-1 out.csv > log` mixes a notice into the redirected stream unless `--quiet` is passed — exactly the redirection failure the change set out to remove.

samples.summary: `ctx`/`status`/`login` error paths emit bare text and `process.exit(1)`, bypassing `outputError`, so the "errors always emit the {error:{code,message}} envelope" contract the diff documents is not true for these entry points
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/ctx.ts:61 (`console.error('Not logged in. Run `wafflebase login`.')` + `process.exit(1)`) and ctx.ts:67; also packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:80 and status.ts:11. `packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:45-50` and `packages/cli/README.md:74-76` now state as a global guarantee that errors are always emitted as the JSON envelope on stderr, but these commands never route through `outputError` — an agent parsing stderr as JSON per that documented contract gets a plain sentence. Fix belongs on these call sites (route them through `outputError`) or on the wording of the new contract.

samples.summary: Several content/export paths hand-roll the error envelope instead of calling `outputError`, so the now-centralised error contract (code extraction, exit-code policy) does not reach them
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/notes.ts:148-150 and 203; packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:195 and 255; packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts:154 and 204 each do `console.error(JSON.stringify(body, null, 2)); process.exitCode = 1; return;` directly. The diff makes `outputError` the single owner of the stderr envelope and its exit-code side effect (formatter.ts:45-56), and the new regression tests only exercise the `outputError` path. Any future change to the envelope (e.g. the exit-code policy discussed on bin.ts) silently misses these six sites, which re-emit the backend body verbatim rather than `{ error: { code, message } }` produced by `errorCode()`.
